'''Fiorah Blys''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who was the daughter of [[Rasmus Blys]], one of [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation's]] [[Special Executive]]s. Fiorah wrote her thesis on the effects of [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] freezing, and became an expert in biological weapons&mdash;[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Juvard Illip Oggurobb]] described her as a "gifted artist" in the field. Oggurobb recruited her to help the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]], albeit remotely from her lab.
